limits: These are faithful native visual compositions, not imports of Minecraft Dungeons proprietary assets or original keyframe data.
Host locomotion uses native equations; action interpolation is adapted to the existing server combat API.
Horse and rider form one DungeonMob. Dismounting and two-entity mount combat are not implemented.
Composite preview bounds conservatively include external gear; actual world captures are still required.
